meta.description: Guesthouses, hotels, yurt camps and cottages on Issyk-Kul. Message hosts and drivers directly on WhatsApp and Telegram, no commission.

home.title: Stays and transfers on Issyk-Kul, direct from the hosts
home.lead: Choose guesthouses, hotels and yurt camps all around the lake, then message the host on WhatsApp or Telegram. No middlemen, no markup.
home.howLead: We connect you with hosts. You agree and pay directly.
home.how1: Filter by village, price, beach and amenities. Map of the whole shore.
home.how2: WhatsApp, Telegram or a call. Hosts usually reply within an hour.
home.how3: No booking fees. Price and terms are agreed with the host.
home.shoreLead: The north shore has beaches and amenities; the south is quiet, with mountains and yurts.
home.ctaTitle: Do you rent rooms or drive tourists?
home.ctaLead: List your place and get requests directly. No commission per booking, just a fixed subscription.
